text_block_list.text:
Gooood morrrrning, Trainy-pii!! Look, 
look! I went around checking out all the 
photogenic spots!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I conquered every single trending spot 
one by one! Before I knew it, I'd looped 
around the whole city☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The amount of photos is crazy, and the 
number of Umastagram likes is insane too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the hype is at an all-time 
high! ☆★ Let's give it all we got today, 
too!
